about: Each league setup's model family, whose icon stands beside the setup's name on the home page: the families and icons of the sibling Decision models site (its page_config.json model_families and family icons of 6 Nov 2026); Open-Jev (Zefan Cai's, not TypeSafe's) is its own family and REAX has one since 9 Nov (Ümit #3635), MiniMax, Inkling and vLLM-SR since 9 Nov (Main, a monogram each; their icons are ours, in the sibling's badge style). A setup belongs to the first family whose match (a regular expression on the setup's shown name) fits; the programs (GNUbg weak, Safest, Random) belong to none. Colours are per maker, not per family: maker_colors.json; a badge icon's square (family_icons.svg) is its maker's colour (maker_palette.json), its mark white or near-black, whichever contrasts more. Muse (Meta's Muse Ember) since 10 Nov (Main; a monogram, ours, in the sibling's badge style; Meta added to the shared palette, logic #4185); its one setup, Muse Ember (max), is held until its late entry is complete (held_setups.json).
